title: Song - Tryggare kan ingen vara
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand waltz accompaniment (bass, then chord, chord)
trains: Tryggare kan ingen vara ("Children of the Heavenly Father") in D major and 3/4, with a one-beat pickup of two eighths, over a waltz left hand (the bass on beat 1, the chord on beats 2 and 3), one chord a bar (D, A, Em, G, Bm).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1299-tryggare-kan-ingen-vara: Tryggare kan ingen vara (hymntune), SATB, D major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1299)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1299), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: The left-hand waltz accompaniment (bass, then chord, chord) is our own (CC0).
